capabilities: insert SRD or homebrew adversary and environment stat blocks into notes and canvases
track HP, stress, conditions, uses, and countdowns per instance on rendered stat blocks
roll attack bonuses and use summon buttons that insert named adversaries
improvise stat blocks from a tier and role following Homebrew Kit guidance
count encounter battle points in the status bar
extras: Release assets are built with GitHub Actions and published with artifact attestations; the README includes a manual install method, local development instructions, and a copyright notice for Daggerheart SRD 2.0 content under the Darrington Press Community Gaming License.
intentEvidence: began as a fork of BeastVault by Lyova Potyomkin
problem: Running tabletop encounters normally means flipping between sourcebook pages and tracking HP, stress, and conditions by hand outside the note the GM is writing in.
